verdict: Maybe, and only within the law. Wholeleaf pitched cannabis-based wellness products on Shark Tank India Season 5 and got a deal from three sharks. Hemp seed foods and licensed ayurvedic products are legal, but anything else is tightly regulated, so check the rules carefully.
angle: Hemp seed oil, protein and licensed ayurvedic cannabis products sell to wellness buyers. Rules differ by product and state, and marketing claims are restricted. Work with licensed suppliers and a lawyer.
